prompts.label: banner
prompts.text: Wide horizontal 16:9 layout (1200px wide) featuring a modern home office setup with productivity and comfort items. Include a sleek laptop on a standing desk, wireless headphones, ergonomic chair, coffee mug, plant, and tech gadgets like a webcam and wireless charging pad. Use a clean, professional aesthetic with coral-orange #FF6B35, teal #00A99D, and golden #FFD700 accent colors. The scene should feel organized and inspiring, representing the ideal remote work environment. Modern flat illustration with soft 3D-style characters and objects, combined with subtle 2D decorative elements. Layout must be clean and giftable, using rounded forms, balanced negative space, and minimal visual clutter. The tone should feel professional, productive, and comfortable — never cluttered or overwhelming. Use text only in social images.

prompts.label: og
prompts.text: Horizontal 16:9 layout (1200px wide) featuring a sophisticated remote work gift collection with premium productivity items: teal #00A99D ergonomic chair, coral-orange #FF6B35 standing desk, golden #FFD700 wireless headphones, and elegant tech accessories. Include floating 3D-style elements like a webcam with ring light, smart water bottle, and meditation app icon. The scene should feel upscale and professional with subtle 2D productivity motifs and sparkles. Arrange items in a clean, editorial style with plenty of breathing room. Modern flat illustration with soft 3D-style characters and objects, combined with subtle 2D decorative elements. Use warm, vibrant pastels (teal #00A99D, coral-orange #FF6B35, sunshine yellow #FFD700). Layout must be clean and giftable, using rounded forms, balanced negative space, and minimal visual clutter. The tone should feel professional, productive, and comfortable — never cluttered or overwhelming. Use text only in social images.
